name: Cityborn {{environment}} — Erreurs
description: Enquête sur les erreurs du backend : quels codes, quelles opérations, quels messages. Les taux d'erreurs sont dans « Cityborn {{environment}} — Activité de l'API ».

query.apl:
['cityborn-backend-{{environment}}']
| where isnotnull(errorCode) and not(route == "<unmatched>")
| summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), errorCode

['cityborn-backend-{{environment}}']
| where isnotnull(errorCode) and not(route == "<unmatched>") and statusCode >= 500
| summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), operation

['cityborn-backend-{{environment}}']
| where isnotnull(errorCode) and not(route == "<unmatched>")
| summarize errors=count(), lastSeen=max(_time) by errorCode, statusCode, event, operation
| top 20 by errors

['cityborn-backend-{{environment}}']
| where isnotnull(errorCode) and not(route == "<unmatched>")
| project _time, event, operation, errorCode, statusCode, errorMessage, client, requestId
| order by _time desc
| take 100
